welcomeBody: Your documents protected, your daily plan, your group always close.
roleSoloD: Personal plans, stories of places, minute-by-minute routes.
roleMemberD: Follow your leader's plan. We alert you if you drift away.
roleLeaderD: Build the plan, see where everyone is, get the alerts.
scanBody: An encrypted copy stays on your phone, even offline. If you lose it, you still have proof.
arrivalD: Train, bus or taxi: times and prices
fromHotel: Departure from Hotel Travertino, Via Cavour
guideTells: Your guide tells the story here
guideTellsD: In a group there are no automatic stories: listen to Marco. Custode only alerts you if you drift away.
lockedD: Your documents are encrypted. Only you can open them, even without internet.
backupNote: Backup copy: show it to police or your embassy if you lose the original.
lostD: We guide you: report, embassy, ready copy.
lost1D: Police or Carabinieri. Nearest: Commissariato Trevi, 650 m. Bring this copy.
lost2D: An emergency passport needs the report and a photo. British Embassy: Via XX Settembre.
lost3D: Works as proof of identity at hotels and checks until your new document arrives.
firstSunday: First Sunday of the month: state museums are free. Long queues, arrive at opening.
priceNote: Indicative 2026 prices: always check the official site.
num112: 112 is the EU single number: police, ambulance, fire. Operators speak English.
sharePosD: With your group leader and a trusted contact
taxiNote: Flat fare to the historic centre, luggage included. Only white taxis from the official rank.
trTip: Only take white taxis with a TAXI sign and licence number on the door. Ignore anyone offering rides in arrivals.
ticketValid: Valid for 1 ride · validate before boarding
edHint: Tap a time to change it, the transport to switch it, ↑ to move a stop.
radiusD: Anyone further than this from the guide gets an alert.
zoneD: The group is outside the Vatican Museums. You are this far away:
zoneLT: Giulia R. is out of the zone
zoneLD: She's near Via della Conciliazione. We've already sent her directions back.
offD: We'll guide you back to your next stop. Walking:
theftD: Termini station and bus 64. Thefts are common here, especially in crowds.
theft1: Backpack on your front, bag zipped and cross-body.
theft2: Phone and wallet in inside pockets, never back pockets.
theft3: Be wary of anyone helping with tickets or bags unasked.
groupCreateHint: You'll get a code to give your members.
needsOnline: You need internet to join the group.
localMode: Local mode: data stays on this phone, shared groups are off.
mrzHelp: The 2 lines with < symbols at the bottom of the photo page.
scanFail: Couldn't read the MRZ. Move closer, avoid glare, or type it in.
scanChecksBad: Some check digits don't match: check the data before saving.
pinCreateD: At least 6 digits. It opens your documents, even offline. Nobody can recover it: don't forget it.
pinShort: PIN must be at least 6 digits
cloudCopy: Encrypted copy also in the cloud
lost1Dx: Police or Carabinieri. Bring this copy.
lost2Dx: An emergency passport needs the report and a photo.
outZoneD: Group is {d} away · tap for directions
noGpsD: Turn on location for safety alerts.
noPlanYet: Your leader hasn't published today's plan yet.
freeToday: Free today: it's the first Sunday of the month
nextFree: Free on the first Sunday of the month · next: {date}
freeResidents: First Sunday free for Rome residents only
onlyLeader: Your group leader sets the plan
ticketHow: Buy on the official site, then save the code or PDF here: it stays in Documents, even offline.
tapGo: Bus, tram and metro: you can also pay with a contactless card at gates and on board.
verifyNote: Check details on the official site.
meetPick: Tap the map to move the point.
msgPh: E.g. Meet at 12:15 under the colonnade
memberOutD: They're {d} from the group. We've already shown them the way back.
zoneDx: The group is this far away:
resetConfirm: Erase documents, plan and settings from this phone?
offlineNow: You're offline: documents, plan and phrases are still available.
theftHere: Thefts are common here, especially in crowds and on transport.
accountD: Link your email to recover documents and group if you change or lose your phone.
checkMail: Check your inbox and confirm the link.
loginD: Enter your linked email: we'll send you a 6-digit code.
restoreD: We found {n} encrypted documents in your account. Enter the PIN you used on your other phone.
startFresh: Start over with a new PIN
bioTitle: Unlock with fingerprint or Face ID
bioD: Enter your PIN to turn it on. Your PIN still works as a backup.
bioUnsupported: This phone doesn't support it: use your PIN.
pushTitle: Alerts even when the app is closed
pushD: Out of zone, SOS, messages and new group plan.
pushDenied: Notifications blocked: allow them in your phone settings.
